# [STORY] As a client app, I want the gateway routing the TMDB facade and auth/account proxy, with the real Filmpire React app running against this backend end-to-end, so that a full real frontend can use the platform, not just curl/Postman

## User Story
**As a** client app
**I want** the gateway routing the TMDB facade and auth/account proxy, with the real Filmpire React app running against this backend end-to-end
**So that** a full real frontend can use the platform, not just curl/Postman

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given the Filmpire React app makes a request, when it goes through the API Gateway, then the TMDB facade and auth/account proxy routes work exactly as the app expects
- [x] Given the live-stack smoke test runs, when it exercises the facade end-to-end, then it passes without manual steps
